What We Do

Plumbing, Heating & Bathrooms — Done Properly

From a leaking tap to a complete new heating system, every job is carried out with the same care, clear communication and attention to detail.

01

Boiler Installation & Repairs

New boiler installations, replacements and repairs — sized and fitted for your home, with honest advice on the most suitable and efficient option.

02

Central Heating

Full central heating systems, radiator installations and upgrades — balanced, efficient heating that keeps every room comfortable.

03

General Plumbing

Leaks, taps, toilets, showers and pipework — everyday plumbing problems diagnosed properly, repaired neatly and left tidy.

04

Bathroom Installation

Complete bathroom installations and refurbishments — from first-fix plumbing through to the final finish, managed as one seamless project.

05

Gas Engineering

Gas appliance installation, servicing and safety inspections — carried out methodically, with every connection checked and tested.

06

Emergency Call-Outs

Burst pipe, major leak or no heating? Calm, practical help when something goes wrong — get in touch and we will talk you through the next step.

About Us

Your Local Plumbing & Heating Specialists

BR Plumbing and Heating provides professional plumbing, heating and gas engineering services for homes of every size. Whether it is a planned bathroom project, a new boiler, or an urgent repair, you deal with a business that takes pride in doing the job properly.

We believe good work speaks for itself: honest advice, clear quotes before work begins, tidy workmanship, and a finish we are happy to put our name to. That approach is why our customers come back — and recommend us to their neighbours.

  • Reliable appointments and clear communication throughout
  • Careful, tidy workmanship in every room we work in
  • Honest advice — we only recommend work your home needs
  • Customer satisfaction at the centre of every job
